method.detection: Same curvature detector and 2/5/10 mm spatial scales as earlier; detect once on the complete human path or active fabrics execution, before reading phase labels into attribution.
method.mapping: Monotone raw arc -> smoothed arc -> original timestamp correspondence. No nearest 3D point matching. Last time retained for identical stationary samples.
method.counting: Whole-path count counts each event once. Phase primary counts assign its curvature-weighted center; overlap lists show all intersected phases and can double-count across phases.
method.boundaries: Only episode endpoints affect smoothing. Phase cuts affect attribution, never detection. Whole-path counts can differ from the previous phase-local analysis.
method.selection: Seven pending demos are all remaining episodes of the previously recorded random sample; not selected by bend geometry.
method.limits: Nine human phase annotations currently. Phase-end progress is not distance to object. Human ring/pole and simulated block manipulation differ; labels for fabrics are controller-based approximations. Unannotated demos contribute no phase-conditioned statistics.
method.generation_next: After user labels, inspect individual joint bend patterns conditioned on phase and displacement; retain combinations from demonstrations rather than independently sampling marginals. Execute candidates via fabrics and compare executed geometry and physical success. No fitted distribution or synthetic generation claimed yet.
